comparison.objective: Tension and latch a cargo strap, then prove restraint during a deck jolt; candidate tunes and locks an industrial-axis damper for controlled stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated ratchet strokes and handle latching versus recessed hex-bit engagement, captive-screw loosening, fine collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and iterative damping adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Requires ≥50 N strap tension, latched handle, and bounded crate motion during one jolt; candidate requires two non-bottoming cycles within travel, energy, velocity, force, rebound, and setting-drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both lock a setting and undergo a dynamic test, but the adjusted mechanism, manipulation sequence, controlled physical quantity, and tested outcome differ meaningfully.
